source: Kiana bridge PipeState.GetReadOnlyResources at each EID; RenderDoc GetBufferData RID 24248 offset 0
shaderUse: PS 31475 instructions 94-124 load t1[0] byte 0,16,32; byte 0 is swizzled wxyz, giving radius 50 and RGB 1,1,1. The shader also loads bytes 28 and 32 later.
note: RID 19818 GPULightDataForChar is a different buffer; it is not bound to PS t1 at these draw events. This binding is evidence, not a complete port of the light response.
